distribution.zero_inflation_note: The point mass at zero is the one unambiguous natural break in the distribution. It is a category, not the lowest class of a gradient: no accepted compound event in 1993-2025.

spatial_autocorrelation.interpretation: Neighbour pairs that share a grid point have identical hazard by construction, so Gi* would measure the association geometry as much as the risk field.

note: Class limits are now stable across regenerations because AUD-11 replaced sample anchoring with fixed goalposts; the record's objection to equal intervals over a Min-Max scale no longer applies.
